data: {"title":"Support","content":[{"_type":"block","_key":"b1","style":"normal","children":[{"_type":"span","_key":"b1-s1","text":"Our apps come with limited support as our time is finite and our apps are mostly provided for the community for free, or for just enough to cover the bills.\n"},{"_type":"span","_key":"b1-s2","text":"We can't guarantee any particular timeframe for response, but generally within one business day (M-F).\n"},{"_type":"span","_key":"b1-s3","text":"Primary means of contact is "},{"_type":"span","_key":"b1-s4","text":"support@muleinstudios.com","marks":["b1-m1"]},{"_type":"span","_key":"b1-s5","text":" but you may catch someone at "},{"_type":"span","_key":"b1-s6","text":"253-457-9440","marks":["b1-m2"]},{"_type":"span","_key":"b1-s7","text":"."}],"markDefs":[{"_type":"link","_key":"b1-m1","href":"mailto:support@muleinstudios.com","blank":true},{"_type":"link","_key":"b1-m2","href":"tel:253-457-9440","blank":true}]}]}
